# VerusLink

> VerusLink is an AI operations concierge for Australian small business owners, based in Sydney. It is not a software tool to learn: VerusLink builds and runs AI workflows inside the tools a business already uses, then operates them, so owners get time back. VerusLink is unrelated to Xerox VersaLink printers.

## What VerusLink does

- Builds and operates AI workflows: lead follow-up, daily owner briefings, expense and receipt tracking, client intake, report generation.
- Done with you, not a tool to learn. A human designs and checks everything; safety and confidentiality are built in.
- Pricing: free AI Health Check, free 15-minute intro call, AI Opportunity Assessment $999 one-time, AI Operations Concierge price on application (a fixed monthly fee, quoted after your Assessment), no lock-in, cancel or pause with 14 days notice. First win in week one.
